topic: Chacha Jee's big entry at the wedding dance.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ki Shaadi Mein Dhamakedar Entry!

shots.narration: چچا کی انٹری دھماکے دار تھی، مگر انجام اس سے بھی زیادہ!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated Pakistani wedding courtyard, floral arch, sunny golden light, scattered rose petals, no text or signage.
shots.action: Chacha strides beneath the floral arch with both arms spread wide.
shots.mood: Grand comic confidence, raised eyebrows, proud moustached smile.

shots.narration: پپو نے پہلے ہی ناچنے کی جگہ دکھا دی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wedding courtyard with a small clear patch between clusters of rose petals, bright fabric decorations, no text.
shots.action: Pappu points toward the clear patch beside Chacha.
shots.mood: Patient guidance, Pappu's helpful smile, Chacha's dismissively confident express

shots.narration: مگر چچا کے قدم چھوٹی جگہ میں کہاں سماتے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, polished wedding courtyard floor edged with loose rose petals, warm sunny colours, no text.
shots.action: Chacha stamps one foot into the petals, sending them outward.
shots.mood: Exuberant comedy, Chacha beaming, Pappu watching with raised eyebrows.

shots.narration: ایک چکر لگا، پھول پورے صحن میں پھیل گئے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful wedding courtyard, rose petals spread across the polished floor, floral arch behind, no text.
shots.action: Chacha performs a broad spinning dance step through the scattered petals.
shots.mood: Joyful chaos, puffed cheeks, delighted concentration.

shots.narration: پپو نے پھول دکھائے، چچا نے داد سمجھ لی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wedding courtyard floor covered in scattered petals, bright upholstered chairs along the wall, no text.
shots.action: Pappu points down at the petal-covered floor in front of Chacha.
shots.mood: Gentle comic misunderstanding, Pappu's patient concern, Chacha's proud grin.

shots.narration: چچا نے فاتحانہ انداز میں آخری پوز بھی دے دیا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny wedding courtyard with petals scattered from the arch to the chairs, no text.
shots.action: Chacha freezes in a triumphant dance pose with one hand overhead.
shots.mood: Over-the-top triumph, Chacha utterly pleased, Pappu quietly amused.

shots.narration: تب چاچی آئیں، ہاتھ میں ایک نیا ساتھی لیے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same decorated wedding courtyard, petal-covered floor, floral arch in the background, no text.
shots.action: Chachi approaches Chacha carrying a plain long-handled broom.
shots.mood: Playful authority, Chachi's knowing smile, Chacha's curious expression.

shots.narration: چاچی نے ناچ کا اگلا ساتھی چچا کو تھما دیا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wedding courtyard amid scattered rose petals, plain broom clearly visible between Chachi and Chacha, no text.
shots.action: Chachi places the broom handle into Chacha's open hand.
shots.mood: Comic reveal, Chachi smiling victoriously, Chacha wide-eyed, Pappu suppressing a

shots.narration: آج جھاڑو نچا لی، کل روٹیاں بیلیں گے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wedding courtyard with petals gathering into a tidy pile, Chachi seated comfortably beside Pappu, a plain wooden rolling pin resting across her lap, no text.
shots.action: Chacha sweeps the petals into a pile with an exaggerated dancing lunge.
shots.mood: Warm comic payoff, Chacha maintaining his proud performer smile, Chachi satisfie

episode.endHook: Agli baar Chacha Jee banayenge bilkul gol roti!
episode.description: چچا جی شادی میں اپنے ناچ سے سب کو حیران کرنے نکلے، مگر پھولوں نے سارا کھیل بدل دیا۔ چاچی جان نے ایسی چال چلی کہ چچا کا ناچ کام بھی آ گیا!
